# Graph operations · coord

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### coord.cameraGrid



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `camera` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `width` | `pixelCount` | Required | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `height` | `pixelCount` | Required | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `radius` | `number` | `14` | {"finite":true} |
| Output | `value` | `cameraGrid` | — | {"layout":"Art-grid dimensions, view matrix, vertical scale, projection and clipping planes"} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#convert-coordinates-time-and-colour-explicitly)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe coord.cameraGrid --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
